User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Disallow crawling of admin and private areas
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /member/
Disallow: /bookmarks
Disallow: /.env
Disallow: /config/

# Disallow crawling of duplicate content
Disallow: /*?utm_*
Disallow: /*?ref=*
Disallow: /*?source=*

# Allow crawling of important assets
Allow: /images/
Allow: /favicon_io/
Allow: /logo.png

# Sitemap location
Sitemap: https://findtheweb.zus3cu.tech/sitemap.xml
